sources.snippet: 💬 Social Media Sentiment Analysis This project focuses on analyzing the sentiment of tweets (positive or negative) using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning techniques. It uses the Sentiment140 dataset containing 1.6 million pre-labeled tweets and builds a classification model using Logistic Regression.
